name: avatar
title: Avatar
description: An image element with a fallback for representing the user.

parts.name: badge
parts.description: Renders an `AvatarBadge` (or any markup) as a root-level sibling of the image/fallback, per upstream's Composition tree — never inside the fallback span.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the avatar. Useful for composition.

props.name: size
props.description: Size variant — also exposed as `data-size` for group/badge styling.

events.name: onStatusChange
events.description: Functional called when the image loading status changes.

examples.title: Basic
examples.source: import Avatar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/avatar/avatar.marko";
examples.description: An avatar with an image, and one falling back to initials when it has no `src`.

examples.title: Basic image
examples.source:
import Avatar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/avatar/avatar.marko";

<Avatar src="https://github.com/shadcn.png" alt="@shadcn" fallback="CN" class="grayscale"/>
examples.description: A basic avatar with an image and a fallback.

examples.title: Fallback
examples.description: Without a `src`, the fallback content renders immediately.

examples.title: Broken image
examples.description: When `src` fails to load, the machine reports an `error` status and the fallback takes over.

examples.title: Custom fallback content
examples.description: Pass a body instead of `fallback` for arbitrary fallback markup, such as an icon.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import Avatar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/avatar/avatar.marko";

Status: ${status}
examples.description: Listen for `statusChange` to react to `loading`, `loaded`, or `error` as `src` changes.

examples.title: Badge
examples.source:
import Avatar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/avatar/avatar.marko";
import AvatarBadge from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/avatar/badge.marko";

<Avatar src="https://github.com/shadcn.png" alt="@shadcn" fallback="CN">
  <@badge>
    <AvatarBadge class="bg-green-600 dark:bg-green-800"/>
  </@badge>
</Avatar>
examples.description: Pass an `AvatarBadge` through the `@badge` slot to add a badge to the avatar, positioned at the bottom right. Use `class` to customize its color and size.

examples.title: Badge with Icon
examples.description: You can also render an icon inside `AvatarBadge`.

examples.title: Avatar Group
examples.source:
import Avatar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/avatar/avatar.marko";
import AvatarGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/avatar/group.marko";

<AvatarGroup class="grayscale">
  <Avatar src="https://github.com/shadcn.png" alt="@shadcn" fallback="CN"/>
  <Avatar src="https://github.com/maxleiter.png" alt="@maxleiter" fallback="LR"/>
  <Avatar src="https://github.com/evilrabbit.png" alt="@evilrabbit" fallback="ER"/>
</AvatarGroup>
examples.description: Use `AvatarGroup` to render a group of overlapping avatars.

examples.title: Avatar Group Count
examples.description: Use `AvatarGroupCount` to add a count indicator to the group.

examples.title: Avatar Group with Icon
examples.description: You can also render an icon inside `AvatarGroupCount`.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.source: import Avatar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/avatar/avatar.marko";
examples.description: Use the `size` prop ("sm" | "default" | "lg") to change the size of the avatar.

examples.title: Dropdown
examples.source:
import Avatar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/avatar/avatar.marko";
import Button from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/button/button.marko";
import DropdownMenu, { type DropdownMenuItem } from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/dropdown-menu/dropdown-menu.marko";

static const ITEMS: DropdownMenuItem[] = [
  { value: "profile", label: "Profile" },
  { value: "billing", label: "Billing" },
  { value: "settings", label: "Settings" },
  { type: "separator" },
  { value: "logout", label: "Log out", variant: "destructive" },
];

<DropdownMenu items=ITEMS class="w-32">
  <@trigger|triggerProps|>
    <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="icon" class="rounded-full" ...triggerProps>
      <Avatar src="https://github.com/shadcn.png" alt="shadcn" fallback="CN"/>
    </Button>
  </@trigger>
</DropdownMenu>
examples.description: Use `Avatar` as the trigger for a dropdown menu.

examples.title: RTL
examples.source:
import Avatar from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/avatar/avatar.marko"; import AvatarBadge from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/avatar/badge.marko"; import AvatarGroup from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/avatar/group.marko"; import AvatarGroupCount from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/avatar/group-count.marko";
<@badge> +٣
examples.description: Avatar, badge, and group markup mirror correctly under `dir="rtl"`.
